description: Source Stream is a precision retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) validation devtool comprising a FastAPI backend that handles document loading, text splitting, embeddings, and Qdrant vector indexing, a React-based UI that provides an interactive step-by-step pipeline workspace, and architecture visualization tooling.

components.name: RAG Pipeline Backend
components.description: FastAPI backend providing REST endpoints and domain services for document ingestion, text chunking, embedding generation, Qdrant vector storage, and RAG query routing.

components.name: RAG Services
components.description: Core RAG business logic encompassing document loading, text splitting, embeddings, vector storage, LLM orchestration, query routing, and guardrails.

components.name: API Routes
components.description: FastAPI route handlers exposing endpoints for document ingestion, text splitting, vector indexing, retrieval querying, and health status.

components.name: Domain Data Models
components.description: Pydantic schemas and data models defining API request bodies, response payloads, and telemetry structures.

components.name: Application Core
components.description: Application configuration settings and logging setup utilities.

components.name: Application Entrypoint
components.description: FastAPI application entry point that initializes logging, configures CORS middleware, and mounts API route handlers.
